commands: xfel version                         # must report chip ID 0x00185900
xfel spinor                          # must report the 64 MiB system NOR
xfel spinor read 0x00000000 1048576 before.bin   # back up the slot first
sha256sum plan-image-fw.bin readback.bin           # both must equal f600eca824e84a43f0691b267bd620e462c50da165c5b80e17aecb7a924f1fa8

gates.reason: No identified ARC-1 board: R10 is on fabrication HOLD.
FEL fall-through recovery on rear USB-C is not bench-proven (R10 change order CO-4).
No recorded owner approval for a board-affecting operation (spec SEC-004).

plan.operation: write plan-image-fw.bin (4096 bytes) to NOR partition F1BT 'F133 boot / selector' at 0x00000000

partition.contents: boot0 (eGON) at 0 + ARC-1 loader at 0x10000; manifest selector
partition.name: F133 boot / selector

risks: A failed write to a boot-path partition can leave the console unable to boot until FEL recovery works.
The xfel SPI NOR sequence was written for R08 (32 MiB NOR) and is unverified on the R10 64 MiB NOR.
This partition is read by the F133 boot ROM.
plan.rollback: Not ready: rollback relies on FEL fall-through, which is bench-OPEN (CO-4).
plan.transport: F133 FEL over rear USB-C (xfel); command sequence UNVERIFIED on R10

failure_reasons.message: partition F1BT is locked (individual block lock) and written by 'factory / recovery header only' only; the SDK will not plan a write to it

warnings: Plan only: nothing was written and no device was contacted
